message.content:
Based on the visual inspection of the time series plot, there is a distinct structural break or level shift anomaly. The data fluctuates around 0 mm for the first part of the series and then abruptly drops to fluctuate around -15 to -20 mm starting at approximately x = 500. This entire second segment can be considered an anomalous range relative to the baseline established in the first segment.

The detected range of anomalies is:
[[500, 730]]
